opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not state their own name, so the greeting is incomplete.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name order number or
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and order number before accessing the account, which is correct, and the caller supplied both.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €75.00 comes back?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the refund question accurately and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll bee another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, and the item arrived 3 working days ago, so the timeline given was wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Thank you, Ahmed. I can see the return of a mirror at €75.00.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so no hold permission step applied; the refund query did not involve a damaged item or bank dispute, so no other required step applied.

communication.quote: Customer: I'm getting a bit worried.
communication.comment: The caller expressed worry and the agent acknowledged it with 'I understand, it's worrying when money is outstanding', but the rest of the call was brief and the agent's tone was adequate.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the a day it's paid. Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, though the next-step confirmation was garbled and the timeline given was wrong.
